plan.title: Refactor
plan.why: Improve an area without changing behavior, backed by a baseline and a green verification path.
plan.what:
## Scope

- State the area to simplify and the behavior that must not change.
- List the non-goals and the constraints.

## Commit strategy

- Baseline, refactor, verify, and document in separate green commits.

milestones.title: Refactor the area
milestones.desc: As a maintainer, I want the area simplified, so that future changes are cheaper. Add inputs and prerequisites.

tasks.title: Establish the baseline
tasks.desc:
Approach: name the tests and checks that prove current behavior.

Commit: baseline slice.

Verify: the baseline suite passes before the change.

tasks.title: Refactor the area
tasks.desc:
Approach: name the structural change and the behavior that stays fixed.

Commit: refactor slice.

Verify: the baseline suite passes after the change.

tasks.title: Test that behavior is unchanged
tasks.desc:
Approach: run the baseline plus the nearest integration checks.

Commit: verification slice.

Verify: every baseline check passes.

tasks.title: Update the documentation
tasks.desc:
Approach: record the new structure where maintainers will look.

Commit: docs slice.

Verify: links and examples resolve.
